findings.claim: Immutable store metadata could still bypass strict graph identity validation and yield schema-invalid envelopes.
findings.resolution: FIXED: one shared compass-model identity validator now guards strict graphs, GraphSnapshotReader metadata summaries, and CodeQueryEngine metadata for every backend. A low-level immutable-store regression constructs empty metadata identities and proves the store reader rejects them.

checked_classes: shared JSON and immutable-store build identity validation
